user.title: Connect Inu
user.description: In Inu, open [Settings → Devices & apps → Home Assistant](https://inuwithyou.com/?page=settings&section=devices), allow task completion and copy the connection key. Paste it here. No MQTT, MCP or YAML is needed.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Inu
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new connection key in Inu Settings and paste it here. Use the same Inu account.

error.invalid_auth: This key is invalid, expired or revoked. Create a new one in Inu Settings.
error.cannot_connect: Inu could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.wrong_account: This key belongs to another Inu account.

abort.already_configured: This Inu account is already connected.

mark_reviewed.name: I reviewed the result in Inu

complete_task.name: Complete a task
complete_task.description: Complete one task in the connected Inu account. Nothing is selected when several names match.

config_entry_id.name: Inu account
config_entry_id.description: Choose an account if several are connected.
